entries.summaryZh: 1918年9月19日至25日，艾伦比指挥的埃及远征军在巴勒斯坦沙龙平原突破奥斯曼军队防线，随后以骑兵向纵深追击。奥斯曼第七、第八集团军迅速瓦解，数万人被俘，英军先后攻占德拉、大马士革与阿勒颇。此役结束了奥斯曼在叙利亚与巴勒斯坦的统治。
entries.summaryEn: From 19 to 25 September 1918 Allenby's Egyptian Expeditionary Force broke the Ottoman lines on the Sharon plain in Palestine and pursued with cavalry into the interior. The Ottoman Seventh and Eighth Armies collapsed and tens of thousands were taken prisoner, after which the British took Deraa, Damascus and Aleppo. Ottoman rule in Syria and Palestine ended.
entries.significanceZh: 米吉多战役是西奈与巴勒斯坦战役的收官之战，直接导致奥斯曼帝国在中东战区的崩溃。
entries.significanceEn: Megiddo closed the Sinai and Palestine campaign and caused the collapse of Ottoman power in the Middle East theatre.
entries.notesZh: 战役以米吉多命名，但米吉多附近实际交战不多，被俘人数各来源为两万五千至七万五千不等；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The battle is named after Megiddo although little fighting occurred there, and prisoner figures range from 25,000 to 75,000; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1918年5月，奥斯曼军队在占领亚历山德罗波尔后向埃里温推进，亚美尼亚国民议会部队在阿帕兰一带阻击。亚美尼亚方面以约六千人在山口设防，经数日激战迫使奥斯曼军队停止前进。此役与萨达拉巴德、卡拉基利萨的胜利一道，为亚美尼亚第一共和国赢得空间。
entries.summaryEn: In May 1918 Ottoman forces advancing on Yerevan after taking Alexandropol were checked by Armenian national forces at Bash Abaran. About six thousand Armenians held the defiles in several days of fighting and stopped the advance. Together with Sardarabad and Karakilisa the victory gave the First Republic of Armenia room to be founded.
entries.significanceZh: 阿帕兰是1918年高加索战役中阻止奥斯曼军队深入东亚美尼亚的三次胜利之一。
entries.significanceEn: Abaran was one of the three 1918 victories in the Caucasus that stopped the Ottoman advance into eastern Armenia.
entries.notesZh: 奥斯曼兵力（约一万三千，含库尔德与土耳其非正规武装）与亚美尼亚兵力均为战时估算；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Ottoman strength of about 13,000, including Kurdish and Turkish irregulars, and the Armenian numbers are wartime estimates; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1942年8月21日凌晨，日军一木支队在瓜达尔卡纳尔岛泰纳鲁河口向美军陆战队阵地发起冲锋。美军以机枪、火炮与坦克封锁渡口与沙洲，日军反复冲击后几近全灭。这是日军在瓜岛战役中第一次大规模陆上攻势，也确立了美军在该岛的防御态势。
entries.summaryEn: In the early hours of 21 August 1942 the Japanese Ichiki detachment charged US Marine positions at the mouth of the Tenaru on Guadalcanal. Machine guns, artillery and tanks swept the crossing and sandbar, and the attacking force was almost annihilated. It was Japan's first major land offensive of the Guadalcanal campaign.
entries.significanceZh: 泰纳鲁河之战击退了日军第一次夺岛反攻，为美军守住亨德森机场赢得时间。
entries.significanceEn: The Tenaru repulsed Japan's first counter-attack on Guadalcanal and bought time for the defence of Henderson Field.
entries.notesZh: 该河在美军地图上曾标为伊鲁河，故又称伊鲁河战役或鳄鱼溪战役；日军阵亡数字各来源为七百余至九百余；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The stream was marked as the Ilu on US maps and is also called Alligator Creek, and Japanese dead are given as 700 to over 900; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 2020年11月，纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫战争中，阿塞拜疆军队向舒沙发起进攻，与亚美尼亚及阿尔察赫部队在城区和周边山地激战数日。11月8日阿塞拜疆宣布控制舒沙，随后三方签署停火协议，亚美尼亚方面交出一批周边地区。舒沙的易手被视为这场战争的决定性转折。
entries.summaryEn: In November 2020, during the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War, Azerbaijani forces attacked Shusha and fought Armenian and Artsakh troops in the town and surrounding hills for several days. Azerbaijan declared control of Shusha on 8 November, a ceasefire agreement followed, and Armenia handed over several surrounding districts. The fall of Shusha decided the war.
entries.significanceZh: 舒沙俯瞰斯捷潘纳克特，其易手直接促成停火协议，是第二次纳卡战争的转折点。
entries.significanceEn: Shusha overlooks Stepanakert, and its capture led directly to the ceasefire and decided the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War.
entries.notesZh: 交战起止日期与双方伤亡在不同来源中差异较大，11月8日为阿塞拜疆宣布控制该城之日；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Sources differ on the start and end of the fighting and on casualties, and 8 November is the date Azerbaijan declared control; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 2002年3月2日至16日，美军、中央情报局准军事人员与阿富汗盟军在帕克蒂亚省沙赫科特山谷发起森蚺行动，围歼基地组织与塔利班武装。美军首次在阿富汗投入大规模常规地面部队，但武装人员大部突围，行动效果与指挥协同受到质疑，暴露出山地协同与情报准备的不足。
entries.summaryEn: From 2 to 16 March 2002 US forces, CIA paramilitary officers and Afghan allies mounted Operation Anaconda against al-Qaeda and Taliban fighters in the Shah-i-Kot valley of Paktia province. It was the first large-scale use of conventional US ground troops in Afghanistan, but most of the enemy escaped and the plan and coordination were widely criticised.
entries.significanceZh: 森蚺行动是阿富汗战争常规地面作战的开端，也成为联军情报与协同失误的典型案例。
entries.significanceEn: Anaconda opened conventional ground combat in Afghanistan and became a case study in intelligence and coordination failures.
entries.notesZh: 武装人员阵亡估计从数十到数百不等，行动日期亦有3月1日至18日的不同记法；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Enemy dead are estimated at anywhere from a few dozen to several hundred and the operation is variously dated 1 to 18 March; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1512年4月11日，法国与费拉拉联军在拉文纳城外与西班牙、教宗联军会战。法军以火炮集中轰击并投入敕令骑士冲击，击溃对方步兵方阵，取得胜利。但法军统帅讷穆尔公爵加斯东·德·富瓦在追击中阵亡，法军随后被迫撤出意大利，此役也预示了步兵方阵在火炮面前的脆弱。
entries.summaryEn: On 11 April 1512 a French and Ferrarese army fought a Spanish and papal force outside Ravenna. Concentrated artillery fire and a charge of gendarmes broke the opposing infantry and won the field, but the French commander Gaston de Foix, Duke of Nemours, was killed in the pursuit and the French soon had to withdraw from Italy.
entries.significanceZh: 拉文纳之战是意大利战争中火炮决定野战的首批战例之一，双方的惨重伤亡也预示了战术变革。
entries.significanceEn: Ravenna was one of the first Italian Wars battles decided by field artillery and its heavy casualties pointed to a tactical turning point.
entries.notesZh: 双方伤亡数字各来源从数千到两万余不等，普遍被认为夸大；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Casualty figures range from a few thousand to over twenty thousand and are widely considered inflated; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1811年11月7日，印第安纳领地总督威廉·亨利·哈里森率美军在蒂珀卡努河附近遭滕斯克瓦塔瓦领导的部落联盟夜袭，双方激战后部落武装撤退。美军随后焚毁先知镇，特库姆塞的联盟受到重创，但土地冲突反而加速，最终导向1812年战争。
entries.summaryEn: On 7 November 1811 US forces under Indiana governor William Henry Harrison were attacked at dawn near the Tippecanoe river by Tenskwatawa's tribal confederacy. After heavy fighting the warriors withdrew and the Americans burned Prophetstown. Tecumseh's confederacy was weakened, but the land conflict deepened and led towards the War of 1812.
entries.significanceZh: 蒂珀卡努之战摧毁了先知镇，也把美国与西北部原住民部落的冲突推向1812年战争。
entries.significanceEn: Tippecanoe destroyed Prophetstown and pushed the conflict between the United States and the northwestern tribes towards the War of 1812.
entries.notesZh: 谁先开火与双方伤亡数字均有争议，哈里森一方的伤亡约为六十余人；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Who fired first and the casualty totals are both disputed, with American losses at about sixty; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元200年，袁绍率大军南下进攻曹操，两军在官渡相持数月。曹操先以轻兵袭取白马、延津，后亲率精兵奇袭袁军在乌巢的粮屯，袁军军心崩溃，主力被歼。此战奠定了曹操统一中国北方的基础，曹操随后收编袁绍余部，逐一平定河北诸州，北方大局底定。
entries.summaryEn: In 200 AD Yuan Shao marched south against Cao Cao and the two armies faced each other at Guandu for months. Cao Cao raided Baimal and Yanjin, then led a picked force to burn Yuan's grain depot at Wuchao; Yuan's army lost heart and was destroyed. The victory made Cao Cao the dominant power in northern China.
entries.significanceZh: 官渡之战是中国古代以少胜多的经典战例，直接决定了汉末北方的归属。
entries.significanceEn: Guandu is the classic Chinese case of a smaller army defeating a larger one and decided who would rule the north at the end of the Han.
entries.notesZh: 袁绍兵力（号称十万以上）与曹军数目出自后世史书，多被认为夸大；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Yuan Shao's army is given in later histories as over 100,000 and Cao Cao's numbers are uncertain, both widely thought inflated; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1868年1月27日至30日，支持明治天皇的新政府军与德川幕府军在京都南郊的鸟羽、伏见一带交战。政府军以萨摩、长州、土佐等藩兵为主，击退幕府军并迫使其退往大阪。此役是戊辰战争的开端，也是幕府权威迅速崩解的标志，德川庆喜随后从大阪撤回江户。
entries.summaryEn: From 27 to 30 January 1868 the forces of the new Meiji government and the Tokugawa shogunate fought at Toba and Fushimi south of Kyoto. Satsuma, Choshu and Tosa troops repulsed the shogunate army and drove it back towards Osaka. The battle opened the Boshin War and marked the rapid collapse of shogunate authority.
entries.significanceZh: 鸟羽伏见之战使新政府掌握军事主动，随后以官军名义推进，戊辰战争由此展开。
entries.significanceEn: Toba-Fushimi gave the new government the initiative as the imperial army and began the Boshin War.
entries.notesZh: 公历日期为1月27日至30日，旧历为庆应三年十二月，部分日文著述按旧历记年；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The fighting is dated 27 to 30 January 1868 in the Gregorian calendar and falls in the twelfth month of Keio 3 in the lunar calendar; this entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前539年，波斯国王居鲁士二世东征新巴比伦帝国，先于底格里斯河畔的奥皮斯击败巴比伦军队，随后西帕尔不战而降，巴比伦城开门迎降。末代国王那波尼德被俘，新巴比伦帝国灭亡，两河流域并入阿契美尼德帝国，居鲁士随后以巴比伦王的名义统治该地。
entries.summaryEn: In 539 BC Cyrus the Great of Persia campaigned against the Neo-Babylonian Empire, defeated its army at Opis on the Tigris and took Sippar, after which Babylon opened its gates to him. The last king, Nabonidus, was captured and Babylonia was absorbed into the Achaemenid Empire.
entries.significanceZh: 巴比伦陷落终结了新巴比伦帝国，也确立了阿契美尼德帝国对整个新月沃地的统治。
entries.significanceEn: The fall of Babylon ended the Neo-Babylonian Empire and gave the Achaemenids control of the whole Fertile Crescent.
entries.notesZh: 巴比伦编年史记该城几乎未战而降，希罗多德等希腊作家则说波斯人引河水入城破城，细节互相矛盾；本条只保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: The Babylonian Chronicle says the city surrendered almost without fighting while Greek writers such as Herodotus describe a diversion of the river; this entry keeps year precision.
